dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Taro has been placed on the at-risk list due to medical and behavioral reasons. Behaviorally, Taro has not had successful interactions. When being approached, she is quick to begin hissing and will start to dart back and forth from one side of the kennel to the other. She does not allow petting even when the scratcher tool is being used. Medically, Taro has had consistent diarrhea, and some episodes of vomiting. We suspect high FAS is contributing to this as well. Due to her ongoing medical and behavior concerns, it is in her best interested to be moved out of the shelter environment and into a quiet, low-traffic home. Taro will need an experienced adopter who can appropriately allow her to decompress as well as addressing her medical needs.
dog.name: Taro
